review:
Angel vs Sinner is a 5x5, 20-line slot that pits heaven against hell. A special heart symbol can turn into an expanding wild with a multiplier from 2x to 100x.

Three scatters award 10 free spins. In the bonus, every expanding wild becomes sticky for the rest of the round, and several can sit on different reels at once, so a few early wilds can produce large multiplied wins on every following spin. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 15,000x. The RTP is 96.56%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
